name: ArtistScope Affiliate Banners
author: ArtistScope

sections.description:
This plugin adds an affiliate banner to your web page or widget.

Unlike other affiliate entrepreneurs that are only interested in your joining fee, ArtistScope has been providing affiliate services for more than 20 years, and it is the only affiliate service that can be trusted.

  • ArtistScope provides the best DRM and copy protection solutions.
  • ArtistScope solutions protect all types of media and scenarios.
  • A variety of products to choose from.
  • Various banner sizes and shapes to suit all web page locations.
  • Use our banners or design one of your own to suit your site theme.
  • Online dashboard to monitor hits and sales.
  • Monthly payout via PayPal, Stripe or bank transfer.
  • 20% commission paid on sales emanating from banner click-though.
  • Affiliate cookies are valid for 45 days.

Note: This plugin connects to a third party service for logging banner activity provided by ArtistScope.

For more information visit the ArtistScope Affiliates website.

  • FREE to join! Register an ArtistScope Affiliate account to be paid commission from sales.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get started.

  1. Upload the “artistscope-affiliate-banners” folder and its contents to “/wp-content/plugins/”.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Register for an AccountID to use in your plugin settings.
  4. For more help see the User-Guide

If you have problems installing, email us from the artistscope.com website for a faster response than the WP forum.
